title: At a repair counter
topic: They are talking about a watch repair. When will the woman come to collect the watch?
levelRationale: N5-oriented polite everyday speech with simple requests, time/place expressions and explicit contrasts. Follow the announced focus rather than remembering every detail. Vocabulary tips identify potentially unfamiliar spoken words; this is not an official JLPT vocabulary or difficulty certification.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: 話を聞いて、質問の答えを一つ選んでください。
turns.translation: Listen and choose one answer to the question.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: 時計の修理について話しています。女の人は、いつ時計を取りに来ますか。
turns.translation: They are talking about a watch repair. When will the woman come to collect the watch?

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: この時計が止まってしまいました。昨日まで動いていたんですが、直せますか。
turns.translation: This watch has stopped. It was working until yesterday. Can you fix it?

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: 見てみますね。電池を替えるだけなら、今日の夕方にはお渡しできます。
turns.translation: Let me take a look. If it only needs a new battery, I can give it back this evening.

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: 今日はこの後、仕事です。夜まで戻れません。お店は何時までですか。
turns.translation: I'm going to work after this today. I can't get back until nighttime. How late is the shop open?

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: 六時までです。明日は水曜日で休みですから、木曜日に来てください。
turns.translation: Until six. Tomorrow is Wednesday and we're closed, so please come on Thursday.

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: 木曜日の午前中は病院に行きます。午後なら来られます。二時ごろでもいいですか。
turns.translation: I'll be at the clinic on Thursday morning. I can come in the afternoon. Is around two okay?

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: はい、大丈夫です。こちらの紙を持って来てください。お名前もお願いします。
turns.translation: Yes, that's fine. Please bring this slip with you. Your name too, please.

options.label: 今日の夕方
options.rationale: This is a possible repair-completion time, but she cannot return then.

options.label: 木曜日の午後
options.rationale: She proposes Thursday afternoon at around two, and the clerk agrees.

options.label: 水曜日の午後
options.rationale: The shop is closed on Wednesday.

options.label: 木曜日の午前
options.rationale: She will be at the clinic then.

explanation: Worked example: distinguish possible completion from the agreed collection time. Today's work, Wednesday closure and Thursday morning appointment leave Thursday afternoon.
